description:
FOUNDING ENGINEER – BATON AI

Location: San Francisco, CA (In-Person)

Experience Level: 3+ years (Full-Stack Engineering)




ABOUT BATON AI

Baton AI (getbaton.ai http://getbaton.ai) is building the enterprise automation platform for cross-application workflows. We’re starting by helping solutions engineering and implementation teams at software companies automate customer onboarding and product setup - enabling them to deliver value faster and at scale. This is just our first wedge toward a broader vision of enterprise-wide, AI-powered automation.

We’re backed by tier-1 VCs and growing fast. Looking for ambitious builders who move fast, take ownership, and want to help define the future of AI automation.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own core systems – Design and build key parts of our full-stack web application, API infrastructure, and AI-driven automation platform.

 - Work on cutting-edge tech – Work on complex technical challenges involving AI agents, prompt engineering, eval, monitoring, API, and browser automation.

 - Shape the product – Collaborate with early customers and the founding team to define our technical roadmap and deliver features that create real impact.

 - Move fast, learn fast – Prototype, experiment, and ship quickly in a high-trust, low-bureaucracy environment.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3+ years of full-stack engineering experience and love working with React and Typescript.

 - Proficiency in modern web application development – React/NextJS and Node.js. Understanding of Python and Elixir/functional programming is a plus.

 - Experience building rich-text editors (think Notion) or excited to take on that challenge.

 - Experience (or strong interest) in building AI/LLM-powered apps and workflow automation tools.

 - A product-minded engineer who cares about clean code and great UX.

 - Problem-solver who thrives on breaking down ambiguity and delivering fast.

 - Excited to work in person with us in San Francisco.




WHY JOIN US?

 - Founding team impact – Help define our culture, product, and technology from the ground up.

 - Customer-first ownership – See your work used and loved by real users from day one.

 - Competitive pay & early equity – Be rewarded for the value you create as we grow.

 - Work on real AI automation – Build a platform that solves meaningful problems with cutting-edge AI and automation.

 - In-person (hybrid) collaboration – We believe the best teams build faster together. We work in person in San Francisco.

Ready to build the future with us? Let’s talk.
